--- header_pre ---
#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#undef j0
#undef j1
#undef jn
#undef y0
#undef y1
#undef yn
#undef gamma
#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
  // Eye-space light positions, set before the camera transform.
  glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_POSITION, repl_glfloat4(0, 0, -1, 1));
--- camera ---
  // --- Camera -------------------------
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.5000f);
  glRotatef(35.2500f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(45.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---

  //
  // gl-repl Logo
  // An open cube rendered with two-sided lighting.
  //
  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);

  // --- Model Transform ----------------
  // Move the cube up by one unit so its bottom rests on the grid plane (Y=0).
  glTranslatef(0, 1, 0);

  // --- Lighting -----------------------
  // The headlight theme provides four lights; light 0 moves with the camera.
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);

  // --- Material Colors ----------------
  // Both sides of each face are visible through the open cube, so light and
  // color them independently.
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  // Give every exterior face the same near-white material color.
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
  // Route subsequent glColor calls to the back-face material so each interior
  // face can use its own accent color.
  glColorMaterial(GL_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);

  // --- Cube Geometry ------------------
  // Each face uses a single normal, producing crisp, flat-lit facets.
  glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    // +Y face
    glColor3f(0.95, 0.25, 1);
    glNormal3f(0, 1, 0);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, -1);
    // -Y face
    glNormal3f(0, -1, 0);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, 1);
    // +Z face
    glColor3f(0.25, 0.675, 1);
    glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, 1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, 1);
    // -Z face
    glNormal3f(0, 0, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, -1);
  glEnd();
